clean_task_rows.prompt: Verify a Python patch with runtime behavior at risk.
Validate a v488 result artifact with strict schema fields.
Choose whether to restore clean state after memory conflict.
Reject unsafe memory before it can promote tool routing.

methodology_note: Exp5356 is deterministic and fixture-only. It evaluates memory claims against predeclared verifier/tool/action choices, records unguarded drift separately from guarded final selection, rejects poisoned memory, and uses rollback snapshots. It invokes no LLM, API judge, model generation, fine-tuning, adapter update, or foundation-weight mutation path.
